scope: S03 portable session migration and prepared protocol ownership
N03 live variable/RNG and SQL-mode consumers
S04 migrated timestamp consumers and transaction admission
behavioral_changes: SHOW/SET SESSION_STATES compose portable user/system values, prepared statements, bindings, warnings, counters and sequence state.
Text and binary prepared IDs share one allocator; original SQL/database survive migration and cached plans are rebuilt. Parameter types survive and execute without a new type vector.
Text and binary prepared SHOW use the same migration handler. Metadata probing avoids executing export; complete row results retain the existing statement-memory authority.
Active transactions, local temporary tables, advisory locks, sandbox mode, bound long-data slots (including empty data) and unconsumed cursors refuse export.
Variable restoration orders depended variables first, logs incompatible variables, restores RNG state through the existing hook and restores warnings last.
Migrated snapshots use the shared historical-read provider and read-only admission.
Grant/revoke executors return OK through the shared statement classifier. SHOW GRANTS uses live SQL mode and shared identifier escaping across all scopes and roles.

grant_consumers_before.method: Temporarily restored the four owning source files to HEAD, ran the new tests, then restored all edits in finally.

session.command: cargo test --locked -p tidb-session --lib -- tests_core::session_state tests_core::transactions tests_prepared_statements tests_prepared_plan_cache tests_user_vars tests_binding tests_session_var_hooks tests_grants privilege::tests

protocol.command: cargo test --locked -p tidb-server --test all -- pipeline_mysql_client_source grants_wire_protocol_source --test-threads=1

cleanup: Removed the OUTFILE unsupported-variant assertion from the unrelated no-op-function test; it encoded a Rust implementation limitation, not a Go no-op contract. OUTFILE completion is not claimed.
Deleted the synthetic grant-resultset run_admin helper after moving every caller to the existing OK-packet helper. Corrected obsolete quoted-account expectations against current Go Escape.
Removed inaccurate parse-only/name-only prepared-store comments. Retained documented unresolved planner/expression differences.
Removed superseded local linker outputs and a previously validated native test executable when disk space became constrained; retained dependency artifacts and current executable outputs.
validation_discoveries: Binding Time JSON must include Go type/fractional precision bits.
SET SESSION_STATES must retain PrevAffectedRows at statement completion.
Binary prepared SHOW exposed an existing missing materialization authority for complete row results; repaired the common owner.

A parallel protocol run observed 3159 instead of 1045 because another test changed process-wide require_secure_transport. The final combined run is serial and passes; no test was deleted or weakened to hide the conflict.
remaining_obligations: Signing-certificate load/rotation/signature validation, token authentication and complete original session_token tests. NULL token is only the unconfigured-certificate path.

Authoritative user-variable FieldType ownership: export currently infers types from the existing Datum owner and imported type maps are validated but not retained. Exact Go-to-Rust typed migration is not accepted.
LastDDLInfo and hypothetical index/TiFlash state, full status flags, legacy binding/error envelopes and full malformed-state/cross-version compatibility matrices.
Full sessionstates/variable/session/server/bindinfo package and original-artifact acceptance. S03 remains partial; N03 and S04 retain broader existing obligations.
publication: Actual precommit locked tidb-server build, fresh locked build immediately before push and remote SHA verification are recorded in Cloud session-migration-batch/final-handoff.json. Never bypass hooks or force-push.
